title: Get FEM Plugin Working End to End
description: Get fem plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏗️fem) working end to end: Rust compiles and tests pass (engine, 2d/3d artifacts, receiving, sqlite, bridge), TS packages build/test, plugin loads in s and exposes its artifacts. Opus 5.5 coordinates, Sonnet 5.5 agents execute, Haiku 5.5 agents explore/audit. Fall back to native tools if the shared work fleet mechanism fails. Fix fundamental unrelated issues found along the way.
summary: End to end on wasm 849acedc, which includes the deferred host aborts from the "Deferred Tool Aborts Under Follow Reads" session and the peer actor-succession change. 2D smoke rc=0: Converged 36/512, then Converged 49/512 after the edit, Live Load Ty 12000 N. 3D: Case: dead with contour, no interaction. The first boot failed with original-turn.succession-unoffered (stale served shard worker from 11-20); native-fem-materialize.ts now also rewrites modules/🧵️shard/🟨️shard-worker.js from shardWorkerSource(), the native stand-in for framework-plugin-web:support. Independent checks: semio-framework-tool-machine 12/12 including the deferred-abort law; typing-edit, instance-render and instance-typed-ops check cleanly. A Sonnet agent ran the FEM session suites (2D 21/21, 3D 3/3), and a Haiku audit found no temporary logs except a per-spawn [TRACE] eprintln in the FEM 3D session-api, now removed (crate checks cleanly).

interactions.summary: FEM plugin works end to end in the browser on the clean wasm e68c95d3 (no temporary prints). 2D: full browser smoke rc=0, Converged 36/512 initially, Converged 49/512 after editing n1 X=1.5 and clicking away, Live Load reaction Ty 12000 N. 3D: Preparing analysis, Solving loads, then results Case: dead after 44 s with no interaction and 0 faults. Fixes: pending effects admitted under their owning instance; roster config partitions for unaddressed windows; TS publishSpawnedJobTerminal repaints the final job frame; child operation identity from the host-bound operation; 2D inspection control_row accessible name; press settlement deadlock (the Commit waited on the tool follow's read lease, which only leftover-budget maintenance advanced), so settle_press now drives the follow, with law a_press_commit_blocked_by_the_follow_read_drives_the_follow (passes natively); panels crate dev-dependency enables artifact-app-testing. Native: law 1/1, 2D inspection 16/16. Open note: the typing settlement has the same read-lease guard. Details in fem-browser-e2e.md.

interactions.prompt: Close the remaining typing-settlement read-lease deadlock (same pattern as the press settlement: a waiting writer blocked by the tool follow's read lease that only leftover-budget maintenance advances).

interactions.author: ueli
interactions.summary: Reopened to close the remaining follow-read deadlocks. The tool follow holds a retained read on the press/gesture/typing row it walks, and every writer of that row refused and re-polled while only leftover-budget maintenance moved the follow. A Haiku audit, confirmed in code, found the typing settlement, typing dispatch commit, scrub dispatch writer and gesture settlement beside the already-fixed press settlement. Fix: one shared follow_before_writer (quotes, funds or names the shortfall, then drives one tool_overlay_retirement_step) called by each writer while the follow holds a read of its ledger: OriginalTypingSettlement::awaits_writer, OriginalTypingCommit::awaits_source, and OriginalToolMachineFollow::reads_presses/reads_gestures/reads_typing over OriginalToolLedgerWalk::window. Laws (3/3 native): press, typing and every-writer. cargo check of typing-edit, instance-render and instance-typed-ops is clean. Rebuilt wasm fdae8851: the 2D smoke passes (Converged 36/512, Converged 49/512 after the edit, Live Load Ty 12000 N), and 3D shows Case: dead with the contour and no interaction. The settle_press doc comment is reattached. Left: gesture/typing abort under a held read is a silent no-op (no spin) and needs a deferred-abort design; other agents' [DEBUG] prints in tool_overlay_retirement_step and the maintenance ladder were left in place. Details in fem-browser-e2e.md.

interactions.prompt: Host aborts (blur, freeze, lapse) of open gestures, presses and typing runs are silently dropped while the tool follow holds a retained read on their slot; make them take effect once the read returns.

interactions.author: ueli
interactions.summary: The deferred-abort follow-up (host aborts dropped while the tool follow holds a read) is owned by its own running session "Deferred Tool Aborts Under Follow Reads", started by the user. A Sonnet agent briefed for the same work was stopped before it edited anything, to avoid two writers on the same ledger files. FEM end-to-end state is unchanged and verified on wasm fdae8851: 2D Converged 36/512, then 49/512 after the edit, Live Load Ty 12000 N; 3D Case: dead without interaction; follow laws 3/3; checks clean. Report: fem-browser-e2e.md (Follow-Up section).
